posts.text:
Yesterday I did the most important broadcast of my life… and I want to lay out exactly what is in it, because if you only catch two minutes you will miss why this matters.

I got access to evidence that came out of federal litigation, Dominion v. Byrne and Dominion v. Powell in DC. Sworn depositions, internal vendor emails from 2006 to 2026, engineering correspondence with Serbia and China, network and virtual machine records. A court sealed that repository. I made the choice to put it in front of you anyway, because what matters more to me than who wins is that the American people are the ones who actually elect them. None of this comes out without Patrick Byrne.

Here is the bottom line of the 19 page brief and the 75 page report going to President Trump…

Engineers who built Smartmatic's software for Chavez and Maduro carried that software, its remote access architecture and themselves from Smartmatic to Sequoia to Dominion, and today they sit at Liberty Vote, Hart InterCivic, Smartmatic and election consultancies. "Same thing, different day, different name, business as usual." That is their own email, not mine.

The emails and testimony I showed describe VPN connections tying Toronto, Belgrade and Denver together, virtual machines set up to reach county election management servers, and a second server sitting in front of the one everybody watches. Results get processed on the first server and only the finished database is passed to the server the Albert sensors monitor, so the sensors never see what happened before that. In Coffee County experts found 965 undocumented API calls into the EMS. In Maricopa the auditors were given one server… the other was never disclosed.

Election night 2020. At 12:12am Eric Coomer emails that they have cartridges with roughly 20,000 cards cast that they may not be able to read into WinEDS… the same WinEDS he testified was not used anywhere in 2020. Another email that night says they used a splitter tool to break a 12,000 result file into 14 batches. Another asks for export results to be zipped and posted to the network. In Michigan a duplicate batch that was supposed to be deleted ended up in the final results. Ben Cotton's forensic work found the scanner creating multiple copies of ballot images in memory, and two foreign IP addresses on a Dominion ICX, one tracing to Taiwan and one to a cloud provider in Germany.

Then the testimony. Coomer told the Fulton County grand jury, the one that produced the indictment of President Trump, that he had no access and no ability to affect an election… then texted that testifying to a grand jury investigating Trump was off his bucket list. In his 2026 deposition he conceded he had multiple virtual machines running in 2020. Wilmer Cardenas testified the engineers did not just have access to the tools… "They invented that tool."

John Poulos told Congress the Chinese parts were commodity components. Dominion's own records show Chinese made motherboards and printer firmware worked on with HP in Shanghai and sent to Serbian engineers, not to America.

And the lineage nobody wants to talk about… a company the Venezuelan government held a 28% stake in, that walked away from CFIUS review in 2006 rather than disclose who owned it, whose founder is now under federal indictment in Florida. Hugo Carvajal, Venezuela's former head of military intelligence, proffered that the Smartmatic system can be altered, was exported to the United States, and has been used to rig elections. The 2026 ODNI assessment addresses none of it.

I did not do this to relitigate who won. I did it because this architecture was never removed. It was renamed. Smartmatic to Sequoia to Dominion to Liberty Vote. 2020, 2022, 2024, 2026. Everybody says it's not the machines… It's the machines. Cloned servers, listeners, splitters, VPN access into Denver and Belgrade. How is that a local election?

This was sealed and kept from the President by people who were supposed to put it in front of him. Pam Bondi's office had access to it.

So here is the ask. @realDonaldTrump, direct the federal investigation of Coomer, Poulos and the engineers, have DOJ seize the sealed repository, and lock down vendor remote access before it is used again. Get rid of the machines, end mass mail in, require ID. Senator Thune, break the filibuster and do your job.

It's our election. It's our country. Watch the whole thing below.

Pray, Stand, Speak, ACT.

🚨 Kevin O'Leary says ANYONE can get rich if they work hard enough.

Then a security guard working 80 HOURS A WEEK challenged him.

The man says 55% of his income goes straight to RENT, and he's applied for HUNDREDS of better-paying jobs without success.

So he had a pretty reasonable question for the multimillionaire:

How much HARDER am I supposed to work?

80 hours is nearly 12 hours a day, seven days a week.

There's only so much week left to work with, Kevin.

Hard work matters. But telling someone who's already working TWO full-time jobs to simply work harder is a pretty difficult argument to defend.
